data.description:
## Bug Report

**Priority**: 2 (important)
**Observed during**: Sprint session close for epic 0b7c-d811 (PR #337)

## Observed behavior
When a session-branch PR has ≥130 changed files (typical for large sprints), the CI llm-review job triggers Strategy F (chunked review). Strategy F dispatches multiple LLM calls across file batches. With 130 files the review consistently exceeds the GitHub Actions job timeout (timeout-minutes: 20 in ci.yml) and is cancelled with '##[error]The operation was canceled.' The PR is left blocked with llm-review in CANCELLED state.

Reproduced twice in a row on PR #337 — not flaky.

## CI evidence
- Run 26358575139: llm-review CANCELLED after 11:16:15–11:36:29 (exactly 20 min)
- Log line: 'INFO: diff exceeds region-split threshold — activating Strategy F file-filter + chunked + aggregated review'
- Warning: 'WARNING: review.large_diff.ignore.glob empty; consider defaults'

## Expected behavior
The llm-review job completes within the 20-minute timeout for normal sprint PRs.

## Root cause options
1. Add review.file_filter.ignore.glob for corpus data files (plugins/dso/data/**/*.yaml) — reduces 130 files to ~49 code files
2. Increase ci.yml timeout-minutes from 20 to 30 or 40 for the llm-review job
3. Both

## Fix
The session was unblocked via /dso:fp-recovery (force-merge with opus manual review: 0 critical/important/fragile findings). Root cause fix still needed to prevent recurrence on future large sprint PRs.
data.title: llm-review: Strategy F 130-file session PR times out at 20min GitHub Actions limit
